mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_access ( site_id, site_code, actor_user_id, actor_user_type, actor_login_id, request_uri, http_method, query_string, referer, client_ip, user_agent, status_code, response_ms, bytes_sent, session_id, trace_id, logged_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at ) VALUES ( #{siteId}, #{siteCode}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserType}, #{actorLoginId}, #{requestUri}, #{httpMethod}, #{queryString}, #{referer}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{statusCode}, #{responseMs}, #{bytesSent}, #{sessionId}, #{traceId}, COALESCE(#{loggedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM log_access WHERE logged_at >= #{statDate} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.sql: log_access_id, site_id, site_code, actor_user_id, actor_user_type, actor_login_id, request_uri, http_method, query_string, referer, client_ip, user_agent, status_code, response_ms, bytes_sent, session_id, trace_id, logged_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at

WHERE logged_at >= COALESCE(#{search.dateFrom}, DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AND logged_at < COALESCE(DATE_ADD(#{search.dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY), NOW())
AND ( request_uri LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR client_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR actor_login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR site_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM log_access
ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT #{search.pageSize} OFFSET #{search.offset}
SELECT FROM log_access WHERE log_access_id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM log_access WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY logged_at ASC LIMIT 200
